title: Satisfaction after pivot extraction
statement: Let $\nu$ be a finite set, choose a variable $v\in\nu$, and let a list of linear equations over $\mathbb F_2$ yield a pivot equation $E$ and a remaining list under pivot extraction at $v$. For any assignment of a value in $\mathbb F_2$ to each variable, all equations in the original list are satisfied if and only if $E$ and every equation in the remaining list are satisfied.
